Ablations are not sufficient to isolate the claimed mechanism. The paper needs stronger controls such as random or mismatched low-fidelity pretraining, equivalent-compute high-fidelity training, freezing vs full fine-tuning, architecture/embedding effects, and negative-transfer cases.

The theoretical analysis is thin. The convergence proof is the standard NPE objective argument, not a result about multifidelity transfer, and the mutual-information/representation discussion is mostly empirical and schematic.

Reproducibility is only partially addressed: code and data are promised after publication, and some important implementation choices, hyperparameter searches, and MF-ABC tuning limitations leave uncertainty about whether the reported gains are robust.
